newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Samson to proceed with Russian oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Samson to proceed with Russian oil deal.

text.p: Samson International Ltd of the United States has confirmed its intent to proceed with a deal to tap 12 oil fields in Russia's central Udmurtia region, Prime-Tass news agency said on Wednesday.
It quoted the head of the region's natural resources committee, Pavel Bondarchuk, as saying Samson had expressed its intent to enter into negotiations for a production sharing agreement.
The region is asking that Samson International, a subsidiary of Samson Investment Company, also find $250 million for the region's Izhmash autoworks.
Tass said the 12 fields have total crude oil reserves of 260 million tonnes.
